function prepare({values}){if(!Array.isArray(values)||!Array.isArray(values[0]))throw Error('Sheet must have a header row');const names=['domain','name','description','processed_at','data','domain_name','traffic','location','funds','year_founded','funding_round','last_funding_at'],header=values[0],columns={};for(const name of names){let indices=header.flatMap((v,i)=>v===name?[i]:[]);if(indices.length!==1)throw Error('Expected one '+name+' column');columns[name]=indices[0]}const rows=[];for(let i=1;i<values.length;i++){const row=values[i];if(!Array.isArray(row))throw Error('Invalid sheet row');const processed=row[columns.processed_at];if(processed!==undefined&&processed!==null&&processed!=='')continue;const domain=row[columns.domain];if(typeof domain!=='string'||!domain.trim())continue;rows.push({row:i+1,domain:domain.trim()})}return{rows,columns}}

const x=prepare({values:$input.first().json.values??[]});return x.rows.map((row,i)=>({json:{row,columns:x.columns},pairedItem:{item:0}}));

function map({row,columns,response,sheetName}){if(!response||typeof response!=='object'||!response.data||typeof response.data!=='object')throw Error('ProspectLens response missing data');const d=response.data,need=(path)=>{let v=d;for(const k of path){if(v===null||v===undefined||typeof v!=='object'||!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(v,k))throw Error('ProspectLens response missing '+path.join('.'));v=v[k]}if(!['string','number','boolean'].includes(typeof v))throw Error('Invalid '+path.join('.'));return v};const vals={domain:row.domain,name:need(['properties','title']),description:need(['properties','short_description']),processed_at:new Date().toISOString(),data:JSON.stringify(d).substr(0,2000),domain_name:need(['info','company_about_fields','website','hostname']),traffic:need(['info','semrush_summary','semrush_visits_latest_month']),location:need(['info','semrush_location_list','0','location_identifiers','0','value']),funds:need(['info','funding_rounds_summary','funding_total','value']),year_founded:need(['info','overview_fields_extended','founded_on','value']),funding_round:need(['info','funding_rounds_summary','last_funding_type']),last_funding_at:need(['info','funding_rounds_summary','last_funding_at'])};if(typeof sheetName!=='string'||!sheetName.trim()||!Number.isInteger(row.row)||row.row<2)throw Error('Invalid sheet location');const name="'"+sheetName.replace(/'/g,"''")+"'",col=i=>{if(!Number.isInteger(i)||i<0||i>=26)throw Error('Column outside A:Z');return String.fromCharCode(65+i)};const data=Object.entries(vals).map(([key,value])=>({range:`${name}!${col(columns[key])}${row.row}`,majorDimension:'ROWS',values:[[value]]}));return{data}}

const prev=$('Loop Over Items').item.json,cfg=$('Choose the sheet').first().json;return [{json:map({row:prev.row,columns:prev.columns,response:$input.first().json,sheetName:cfg.sheetName})}];
